descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S24 「手机宽度和 WebKit 上的计费卡：代码、级别和长引用看得清，没有被截断」 Billing card on phone width and WebKit: code, level and long quotes readable, nothing cut off

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Visual lane targets Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Open Post-Round with a seeded billing suggestion whose quotes are long, in both contexts

Then The code and level are visible without horizontal scroll, quotes wrap, the retry / time buttons are at least 44 px tall

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual-checks.ts: no horizontal overflow, tap-target size, screenshot kept as evidence

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S24

Billing card on phone width and WebKit: code, level and long quotes readable, nothing cut off

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for pr); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：encounter.spec.ts (phones only): billing with a 300-character RISK quote (both), CODE/LEVEL line inside the screen, quote wraps, retry button >= 44 px tall. [2026-10-14 review] Re-run with the stricter 'covered' rule (a fixed layer over a fixed layer is high). — Time-choice buttons need the discharge prompt (PR #103), not on main.

Detail:

iphone15, pixel7: 28 judged check(s) passed, 0 failed. CODE and LEVEL lines are inside the screen, the 300-character RISK quote wraps, the retry button is ≥ 44 px tall, on Pixel 7 and iPhone 15.

证据：附了 6 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-18_S24 — 目录（14 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
